head: incident

families.routine_presence: public presence with replay/real and confirmed-track variation, including recognized non-intrusive presence
families.perimeter_presence: private perimeter crossings with access, alarm, gap and capability variation
families.threshold_presence: restricted threshold candidate/confirmed sequences with armed/triggered sensor contradiction
families.anomaly: human-absent sensor/movement/alarm contradictions across all topologies
families.action_failure: human-present states with simulated failure, unavailable and capability-unavailable outcomes
families.technical: detector/peripheral unavailable states without human evidence
families.resolved: final calm states with replay/real and residual sensor variation

split_policy: family, template, seed, topology and sequence namespaces are disjoint; redteam-v1 and redteam-v2 are never training inputs
